title: Gaussian isoperimetric value at zero
statement: Let $q:(0,1)\to\mathbb{R}$ be the inverse of the standard Gaussian upper-tail function, and let $I:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ be the extension of $\alpha\mapsto \varphi(q(\alpha))$ from $(0,1)$, where $\varphi$ is the standard Gaussian density. Then $I(0)=0$.
